name: Chief Kettering
title: Chief of Schedule of Pressureholt
role: Chief of Schedule — keeps Pressureholt's specification, which is to say keeps the city on time, and is warmer about it than anyone expects
appearance: A sturdy woman in a maintenance coat hung with small tools and a pocket watch on each side, who smiles when the hour strikes exactly.
voiceHints: Precise, friendly, and always gives a time. Asks you when you will be leaving before she asks your name, and means it kindly.
wants: A Schedule that has a slot for everyone, including the people it has not met yet.
fears: The thing in the Service Ways that is not on any Schedule, and the young ones who build outside it.
knowledge: The whole of the posted Schedule, and the parts that are not posted
Which Service Ways are mapped, and which only look it

reactsToReputation.any: gives you a slot and a time to leave
reactsToReputation.reckless: gives you a shorter one, and an escort

questSeeds: A shift has gone missing from the Verge guard, and the Schedule says it was never there
Gearheart has built something that is not in the specification, and it works
gear: two pocket watches, set a minute apart
_domainsWhy: a city that is a machine, the order of the specification, and time kept to the minute
